spec2def(openglcfg.cpl openglcfg.spec)

add_rc_deps(openglcfg.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/openglcfg.ico)

# openglcfg.cpl is all Rust (openglcfg-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# openglcfg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-rust/src/openglcfg/openglcfg.rs)
# general.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-rust/src/openglcfg/general.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(openglcfg_res OBJECT openglcfg.rc)
target_compile_definitions(openglcfg_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(openglcfg_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(openglcfg openglcfg-cargo openglcfg.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE openglcfg-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS openglcfg_res)
